replacements.text: The agent running a review round chose each reviewer's effort and tools. The panel's configuration file now pins effort and tools for every reviewer slot. Each reviewer receives the change as a diff file. The recovery sequence sets how a run that dies is retried. The panel does not yet check whether a run used its pinned effort.
The gates ran with the system bash first on PATH. The Homebrew bash hangs one hook test.
The code reviewers last judged commit e399db1d. Four prose-only commits followed.
The author's machine holds the 27 raw answers that test the written dispatch rules. They are outside the repository.
A reviewer runs at an effort level or with tools it cannot use.
The system retries a run that died one effort step lower. It then retries on the other provider. The round halts if that attempt dies too.

questions.question: The tests establish that every slot has a pin, but do they establish that a reviewer cannot run with incompatible effort or tools? Please provide evidence for that risk or revise the evidence claim.

Please move the caveat that the round halts only when the last failure on every route was a run that died or a transport error to a Heads-up row. The current change text omits this limiting condition to meet the one-clause-per-sentence check.
